svg.title: (c) Dataflow mapping on the same physical PE mesh
svg.text: (c) Dataflow mapping on the same physical PE mesh
Blue: A operand; teal: B operand; orange: partial sum. Resident state is inside each PE; all inter-PE hops are registered.
A/B: W bits; local acc: P bits
A: W bits; south psum: P bits
B: W bits; east psum: P bits
Matching products align at t = i + j + k. OS completes locally; WS retires at the bottom edge; IS retires at the right edge.
Internal multiply/add drawings show a shared MAC abstraction; exact operand muxes, state enables, and output-zero muxes are in the PE datapath.
